title: pfSense — Firewall Blocks
description: Firewall blocks logged by pfSense and retained in Graylog. Parsed details use the indexed filterlog fields.

panels.title: Logged blocks
panels.description: Counts filterlog records across the selected time range. Firewall traffic without logging is outside this view.

targets.query: gl2_source_input:"${syslog_input:raw}" AND gl2_remote_ip:"${firewall_sender:raw}" AND source:filterlog* AND facility:local0 AND message:("block in" OR "block out")

panels.title: Parsed blocks
panels.description: Uses indexed block fields. Compare Parsed blocks with Logged blocks when viewing older periods.

targets.query: gl2_source_input:"${syslog_input:raw}" AND gl2_remote_ip:"${firewall_sender:raw}" AND source:filterlog* AND facility:local0 AND pfsense_action:block

panels.title: pfBlockerNG blocks
panels.description: Verified against active pfBlockerNG rule trackers when enrichment was configured.

targets.query: gl2_source_input:"${syslog_input:raw}" AND gl2_remote_ip:"${firewall_sender:raw}" AND source:filterlog* AND facility:local0 AND pfsense_action:block AND pfsense_rule_source:pfBlockerNG
